name: LoadItemsTable
plate_comment:
Loads Tables\items.sav (252000 bytes, 500 slots) into m_items[500].
Slot: int present. 0 -> 4-byte empty slot (m_items[i] = NULL). Otherwise 508 bytes:
  int present, E_ItemRecordType (0 ammo, 1 animated, 2 static), 500-byte C_ItemDef::Load stream.
An unknown record type only skips 8 bytes, desynchronising the rest of the file.
I/O error: message box, C_game state = 4 (quit). Layout notes: _re/types/30_items.spec.
